title: finish: scope the local gate to the diff, skip re-gating on intervening merges
goal: Run fmt always; run clippy/check/test only for crates affected by the branch diff (scripts/ci-changed-crates.sh), full workspace only for ALL diffs or SUSI_LOCAL_GATE=full.
